notes:
Derived metadata that make the partitions and measurements of the accompanying crack-segmentation study reproducible: split index files, per-file SHA-256 manifests of the audited dataset copies, machine-readable benchmark results, and the scripts that verify a local download and regenerate the partitions. No images or annotations from the four source datasets (DeepCrack, Crack500, CamCrack789, CrackMap) are redistributed here; those remain under the terms set by their original authors.

The accompanying manuscript is not yet published and has no DOI, so this record deliberately carries no related identifier pointing to it. An isSupplementTo relation will be declared once that DOI exists, and will appear on versions archived from that point onward.

This record's metadata is declared in the repository's .zenodo.json rather than inferred from GitHub. That file was added after v1.3.0, so the records for v1.0.0 through v1.3.0 keep the metadata Zenodo derived at the time — a single creator and a software resource type — and are not revised retroactively.
